verdict.rationale: monday.com's own docs say users can describe a workflow in plain language to create an agent, define its goal and rules, automate scheduled status reports, and connect thousands of tools with no development needed. That is first-party no-code automation, but the evidence never documents a multi-step automation builder (chained triggers, conditions and actions) or shows how deep these flows go. missing for 10: explicit documentation of chaining multiple steps or conditions without code, detail on the automation builder itself, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can build multi-step automations without writing code
